coder_notes: Enzastaurin arm is registry-typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR, but functionally experimental (placebo-controlled add-on to Stupp); coded experimental_monotherapy and flagged. Placebo not listed as an agent. Requires IDH non-mutant and cites WHO 2016 -> cns5 per tie rule. DGM1 and MGMT status must both be known before randomisation; the record does not explicitly name them as randomisation strata, so 'stratification' is inferred (alternative exploratory_correlative). Title 'With or Without' DGM1 vs official title 'Who Possess' DGM1 conflict. DGM1 nature (tumour vs germline) not stated in record. IDH quote is from exclusion criteria (IDH-mutant excluded).
